installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# PHP-FPM Installation Script
#

VALID_VERSIONS=("8.3" "8.4" "8.5")

if [[ ! " ${VALID_VERSIONS[@]} " =~ " ${PHP_VERSION} " ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: PHP_VERSION must be 8.3, 8.4, or 8.5 (detected: ${PHP_VERSION})"
    exit 1
fi

apt-get update
apt-get install -y wget
wget -O /etc/apt/trusted.gpg.d/php.gpg https://packages.sury.org/php/apt.gpg
echo "deb https://packages.sury.org/php/ bookworm main" > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/php.list
apt-get update
apt-get install -y php$PHP_VERSION-fpm

# Copy PHP-FPM config
cp -afv /etc/php/$PHP_VERSION/fpm/ /mnt/server/
rm -rf /mnt/server/fpm/conf.d/*

# Create PHP-FPM logs directory
mkdir -p /mnt/server/fpm/logs

# Create PHP-FPM tmp directory
mkdir -p /mnt/server/fpm/tmp

# Create PHP-FPM upload tmp directory
mkdir -p /mnt/server/fpm/tmp_upload

# Create PHP-FPM sessions directory
mkdir -p /mnt/server/fpm/sessions

# Create html directory
mkdir -p /mnt/server/html



# Replace php-fpm.conf
sed -i "s#^pid = /run/php/php$PHP_VERSION-fpm.pid#pid = /home/container/fpm/tmp/php-fpm.pid#" /mnt/server/fpm/php-fpm.conf
sed -i "s#^error_log = /var/log/php$PHP_VERSION-fpm.log#error_log = /home/container/fpm/logs/php-fpm.log#" /mnt/server/fpm/php-fpm.conf
sed -i "s#^include=/etc/php/$PHP_VERSION/fpm/pool.d/\*.conf#include = /home/container/fpm/pool.d/\*.conf#" /mnt/server/fpm/php-fpm.conf



# Replace www.conf
sed -i "s#^user = www-data#;user = container#" /mnt/server/fpm/pool.d/www.conf
sed -i "s#^group = www-data#;group = container#" /mnt/server/fpm/pool.d/www.conf
sed -i "s#^listen = /run/php/php$PHP_VERSION-fpm.sock#listen = 0.0.0.0:$SERVER_PORT#" /mnt/server/fpm/pool.d/www.conf
sed -i "s#^listen.owner = www-data#listen.owner = container#" /mnt/server/fpm/pool.d/www.conf
sed -i "s#^listen.group = www-data#listen.group = container#" /mnt/server/fpm/pool.d/www.conf



# 99-custom.ini
cat > /mnt/server/fpm/conf.d/99-custom.ini << 'EOF'
; Maximum amount of memory a script may consume
; https://php.net/memory-limit
memory_limit = 128M

; Maximum size of POST data that PHP will accept.
; Its value may be 0 to disable the limit. It is ignored if POST data reading
; is disabled through enable_post_data_reading.
; http://php.net/post-max-size
post_max_size = 105M

; Maximum allowed size for uploaded files.
; http://php.net/upload-max-filesize
upload_max_filesize = 100M



; This directive allows you to disable certain functions.
; It receives a comma-delimited list of function names.
; https://php.net/disable-functions
disable_functions = "propro,pcntl_alarm,pcntl_fork,pcntl_waitpid,pcntl_wait,pcntl_wifexited,pcntl_wifstopped,pcntl_wifsignaled,pcntl_wifcontinued,pcntl_wexitstatus,pcntl_wtermsig,pcntl_wstopsig,pcntl_signal,pcntl_signal_get_handler,pcntl_signal_dispatch,pcntl_get_last_error,pcntl_strerror,pcntl_sigprocmask,pcntl_sigwaitinfo,pcntl_sigtimedwait,pcntl_exec,pcntl_getpriority,pcntl_setpriority,pcntl_async_signals"

; Log errors to specified file. PHP's default behavior is to leave this value
; empty.
; https://php.net/error-log
; Example:
error_log = "/home/container/fpm/logs/php_errors.log"

; Directory where the temporary files should be placed.
; Defaults to the system default (see sys_get_temp_dir)
sys_temp_dir = "/home/container/fpm/tmp"

; Temporary directory for HTTP uploaded files (will use system default if not
; specified).
; https://php.net/upload-tmp-dir
upload_tmp_dir = "/home/container/fpm/tmp_upload"

; Argument passed to save_handler.  In the case of files, this is the path
; where data files are stored. Note: Windows users have to change this
; variable in order to use PHP's session functions.
;
; The path can be defined as:
;
;     session.save_path = "N;/path"
;
; where N is an integer.  Instead of storing all the session files in
; /path, what this will do is use subdirectories N-levels deep, and
; store the session data in those directories.  This is useful if
; your OS has problems with many files in one directory, and is
; a more efficient layout for servers that handle many sessions.
;
; NOTE 1: PHP will not create this directory structure automatically.
;         You can use the script in the ext/session dir for that purpose.
; NOTE 2: See the section on garbage collection below if you choose to
;         use subdirectories for session storage
;
; The file storage module creates files using mode 600 by default.
; You can change that by using
;
;     session.save_path = "N;MODE;/path"
;
; where MODE is the octal representation of the mode. Note that this
; does not overwrite the process's umask.
; https://php.net/session.save-path
session.save_path = "/home/container/fpm/sessions"

; Sets the directory name where SOAP extension will put cache files.
; https://php.net/soap.wsdl-cache-dir
soap.wsdl_cache_dir = "/home/container/fpm/tmp"

; Absolute path used to store shared lockfiles (for *nix only).
opcache.lockfile_path = "/home/container/fpm/tmp"
EOF

# php-info.php
cat > /mnt/server/html/php-info.php << 'EOF'
<?php
phpinfo();
EOF
